notes.title: Meow Path 2 is now available!
notes.content:
🎉 Meow Path 2 is now available! 🐾
A brand-new cat adventure begins today!
This sequel comes with even more content and fun!

More new levels to explore

New difficulty levels for those who love a challenge

Level editor – create your own path for the cat to follow

More adorable cat images added

Quality-of-life improvements for smoother, more comfortable gameplay

And much more!


Version 1.0.0
150 Main Levels (Stages 1–150)

500 Side Levels (Stages 1–500)

23 Achievements to unlock

3 little cats
